fixed_model: V26 epoch390 selected by frozen minimum VAL MSE; no optimizer or retraining

timing.includes: Native geometry pooling, encoder, MLP, interpolation, curl, gauge and mask
timing.excludes: Host transfer, rendering and input-independent coordinate stencil setup

boundary.obstacle: All native-mask half-cell faces, same approximation as training
boundary.target: Top wall (1,0), other outer walls and obstacle (0,0); unit lid velocity
boundary.reference_note: First/last pixel centres are not the mathematical wall. Compare prediction/reference there separately.

differential.coordinates: Same cell centres for continuous autograd and float64 FD
differential.description: Sampled-prediction must match native-grid stencil; AD vs FD curl/NS are separately reported, no invented accuracy threshold

reporting: All cases, raw repeated timings, fresh errors/physics, exact-wall and pixel-centre diagnostics, AD/FD consistency and representative/worst images. No new accuracy acceptance threshold.
large_files: Only on Perun. Local export limited to JSON/TXT/LOG/PNG ZIP.
